data.title: 木更 · 阳台月色
data.description: 【木更 · 阳台月色】深夜海风轻拂的公寓小阳台上，只披着薄纱里衣的木更倚靠在铁栏杆旁，清冷月光将她曼妙诱人的身躯线条勾勒得如梦似幻。她轻咬着下唇回眸望你——「外面的风有点冷呢……修，不过来从背后抱紧我，替我挡住夜风吗？」
data.lighting: cool moonlight and warm room glow
data.promptProse: Adult Kisara leans against the balcony railing in her pale-pink sheer nightgown and looks back toward the viewer. Cool moonlight defines the outer edge of her silhouette while warm room light reaches her face from inside.
data.animaCaption: She looks back from the railing, warm room light reaching her face from inside.
